name: Processing of Application for Change of Enrollment — Adding of Subject
processing_steps: Accept, evaluate, and sign the ACE Form (Adding of Subjects)
Tag the subject(s) indicated in the ACE Form
Accept payment and issue official receipt (for students not covered by R.A. 10931)
Accept the fully accomplished ACE Form
Submit ACE Form to Registrar's Office
expected_output: Enrolled additional subject/s tagged in SIS

name: Processing of Application for Cross-Enrollment
processing_steps: Evaluate letter provided by the student
Approve or deny request for cross-enrollment
If approved, recommend cross-enrollment and advise student to proceed to the Registrar's Office
Approve cross-enrollment
Issue permit to cross-enroll
Advise student to process the permit to the university where student intends to cross-enroll
expected_output: Permit to cross-enroll issued to the student

name: Processing of Manual Enrollment
processing_steps: Accept and sign the R0 form (Faculty member assigned to the subject)
Accept, evaluate, and sign the R0 form (Director/Head of Academic Program)
Tag the subject(s) indicated in the R0 Form
Accept payment and issue official receipt (Cashier's Office)
expected_output: Student manually enrolled and subjects tagged in SIS

name: Processing of Application for Overload of Subjects
processing_steps: Check requirements presented
Verify correctness of documents by checking the SIS grade file of the student
Recommend the request for approval of the Director
Approve or deny the request (Campus Director)
Add corresponding units in the student account through SIS Academic Management System
Advise student to proceed to Application for Change of Enrollment Process (Adding of Subject/s)
expected_output: Overload units added to student SIS account; student proceeds to ACE process

name: Processing of Application for Correction of Grade Entry, Late Reporting of Grades and Removal of Incomplete Mark
processing_steps: Accept payment and issue an official receipt
Evaluate the requirements; compute and give grade to the student
Receive the accomplished completion form, class record, and student requirements with notarized affidavit
Sign the Completion Form
Log and forward all requirements to the Registrar's Office
Sign the Completion Form and tag the accomplished grade to SIS
Return one (1) copy of the completion form to the student
required_documents: Notarized Affidavit for Change of Grade
expected_output: Corrected or completed grade tagged in SIS; student receives copy of completion form

name: Application for New Identification Card
processing_steps: Submit filled-out application form for new ID to the Office of Student Affairs and Services
Seek approval of the request by the OSS Director
Pay the corresponding fee at the Cashier's Office
Proceed to OSS for processing and issuance of printed ID
Sign in the OSS logbook
expected_output: Printed Identification Card issued to the student

name: Application for Replacement of Lost Identification Card
processing_steps: Submit filled-out replacement ID form to the Office of Student Affairs and Services
Pay corresponding fee at the Cashier's Office
Present official receipt for processing and issuance of replacement ID
Sign in the OSS logbook
expected_output: Replacement Identification Card issued to the student

name: Consultation Service
processing_steps: Proceed to front desk and present required documents
Sign in the client logbook
Accomplish Appointment Slip; assigned to counselor
Undergo background verification with counselor
Collect information for the topic or area to be consulted
Secure appointment slip for follow-up session if needed
required_documents: Letter of Request noted by Faculty/Chair/Dean
expected_output: Consultation conducted; follow-up appointment provided if necessary

name: Counseling Service
processing_steps: Proceed to front desk and present required documents to schedule a counseling session
Sign in the client logbook
Accomplish the Personal Data Sheet
Undergo initial assessment: interview, gather information, discuss counseling procedures
Secure appointment slip for additional sessions if needed
expected_output: Counseling session conducted; follow-up session scheduled if required

name: Issuance of Recommendation Letter
processing_steps: Present required documents; receive logbook and sign in
Accomplish Exit Interview Form
Undergo background verification
Issuance of the Recommendation Letter
expected_output: Recommendation Letter issued to transferring or graduating student

name: Consultation and Treatment Services for Emergency Dental Cases of Students — With Referral
processing_steps: Go to the receiving area and state the reason for consultation or chief complaint
Dentist takes patient's vital signs
Dentist assesses and evaluates condition by oral examination and medical history
Dentist provides immediate treatment/intervention
With referral: Refer to the medical section and explain the reason for referral
With referral: Prepare referral form to a nearby hospital and arrange emergency transport
Proceed to the receiving area and receive initial dose of medicine if available
Fill out and sign in the Daily Treatment Record (DTR)
expected_output: Emergency dental treatment provided; referral form issued to nearby hospital if needed

name: Consultation and Treatment Services for Non-Emergency Dental Cases of Students and Dependents — For New Patients
processing_steps: Go to the receiving area and state the reason for consultation or chief complaint
Dentist takes patient's vital signs
Dentist instructs patient to proceed to the treatment area
Provide necessary information and submit to oral examination
Dentist takes medical history and performs oral examination
Dentist provides treatment
Listen to home instructions and date of follow-up
Dentist discharges instructions and schedules follow-up
Proceed to receiving area and receive prescription or referral slip
Fill out and sign the Daily Treatment Record
expected_output: Non-emergency dental treatment provided; prescription and follow-up date issued

name: Consultation and Treatment Services for Emergency Medical Cases of Students — With Referral
processing_steps: Go to the receiving area and state the reason for consultation or chief complaint
Physician takes patient's vital signs (BP, Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Pulse Rate)
Physician assesses and evaluates the condition by medical history and physical examination
Physician provides immediate treatment/intervention
With referral: Explain the reason for referral and prepare referral form
With referral: Prepare emergency transport vehicle for patient conduction
Proceed to the receiving area and receive initial dose of medicine if available
Fill out and sign in the Daily Treatment Record (DTR)
expected_output: Emergency medical treatment provided; referral form issued to nearest hospital if needed

name: Consultation and Treatment Services for Non-Emergency Medical Cases of Students and Dependents — For New Patients
processing_steps: Go to the receiving area and state the reason for consultation or chief complaint
Physician takes the patient's vital signs (BP, Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Pulse Rate)
Physician instructs patient to proceed to consultation area
Provide necessary information and submit to physical examination
Physician takes medical history and performs physical examination
Physician provides treatment
Listen to discharge instructions and date of follow-up
Physician provides discharge instructions and referral slip if necessary
Proceed to receiving area and receive prescription or referral slip
Fill out and sign the Daily Treatment Record
expected_output: Non-emergency medical treatment provided; prescription and follow-up date issued

name: Issuance of Follow-up of Students Referred During Enrollment
processing_steps: Go to the receiving area of the medical clinic and state the purpose of consultation or follow-up
Physician retrieves patient record and asks for follow-up purpose
Present laboratory results or other required documents
Physician checks results and takes vital signs including weight for PTB cases
Physician assists student to the consultation area
Proceed to the consultation area; submit laboratory results and fill out waiver form
Physician assesses and evaluates documents submitted
Physician takes medical history and performs medical examination
Listen to home instructions
Physician provides discharge instructions
Proceed to the receiving area and sign the Registration Form
required_documents: Laboratory results requested by the Physician (Original Copy)
expected_output: Follow-up consultation completed; medical record updated; further referral or treatment provided if needed
